commands: echo "RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID ATTEMPT=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; git status --porcelain; echo "---PRVIEW---"; gh pr view 1486 --json headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,body,title,state --jq '.'

for f in "a/lib/test/run.sh" "a/skills/implement/phases/phase-3-review.md" "a/skills/implement/phases/phase-4-documentation.md" "a/skills/review-and-fix/references/loop-exit.md" "a/skills/review-and-fix/references/shadow-review.md" "a/scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json"; do echo "===== $f ====="; awk -v tgt="diff --git $f " '$0 ~ "^diff --git " {p=($0 ~ tgt)} p' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1486/cloud/diff.patch; done

ls .changeset/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat .changeset/config.json 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---existing sample---"; for f in .changeset/*.md; do [ "$(basename $f)" != "issue-1453-review-coverage-gate.md" ] && head -5 "$f" && break; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
